diagnosis.overview: The agent lacked a reliable mechanism to precisely extract numeric data from source documents, forcing it to generate generic approximations, miss required data points, and exhaust iteration limits without producing complete outputs.
diagnosis.root_cause: The agent lacked a reliable mechanism to precisely extract numeric data from source documents, forcing it to generate generic approximations, miss required data points, and exhaust iteration limits without producing complete outputs.
diagnosis.general_mechanism: Wire in a dedicated PDF/table extraction tool (e.g., pdfplumber) with bindings to extract exact values from financial documents; add a mandatory prompt rule that requires all specified data fields and formatting elements be explicitly extracted and populated before any verification step; implement an early-abort middleware that halts if required data points remain missing after the first extraction attempt.
